---
title: "AI detection"
description: "Limits of automatic AI-text detection and safer alternatives."
---

This chapter should explain why automatic detection cannot provide sufficiently reliable proof of AI use and why stylistic clues are not dependable evidence.

::: {.callout-warning title="Do not use as proof"}
An AI detector score should not, by itself, be used to accuse a student of misconduct.
:::

## Better alternatives

Document the assessment process, request intermediate work where useful, discuss the work with the student, and evaluate whether the submitted work demonstrates the intended learning outcomes.
